interview.name: Tess
interview.answer: The repair drive is still at the community hall, but the exact time hasn’t been confirmed yet.

reflections: Tess is supportive and keeps community coordination moving by offering reminders and practical help.
Oren wants to contribute but is currently distracted, so a gentle follow-up would likely help.
